title: How Interleaf was researched and built

research_method.evidence_sweeps: Structured subagent query sweeps over the staged literature; one recorded sweep ran 46 queries with mandatory counterevidence families
research_method.reception_checks: Scite search_literature DOI calls tallying supporting/contrasting/mentioning citations and editorial notices; consensus-style synthesis across sweeps
research_method.honesty_limits: Citation quota exhaustion mid-matrix was recorded; unchecked rows were stamped reception-unverified rather than assumed

deterministic_core.design_thesis: Parse agreements into code-like structure (sections, cross-references, norms) and run deterministic checks against an operator position library, with objective gates before release; not LLM-as-judge.

formal_engines.attests: structural soundness only; not per-clause computation from arbitrary prose
formal_engines.correction: An earlier write-up overstated Catala as verifying the clause; a design review corrected the scope and re-based the cross-check onto the per-document engines.

formal_engines.attests: whether exceptions or priorities override an obligation for curated fragments

hallmark_wiring: Engine results, cross-check corroboration between per-document engines, and the exception gauntlet feed the Hallmark evidence marks shown on this case page.
recorded_proofs: Recorded engine checks on May 29, 2026 covered the limitation-of-liability clause family; coverage beyond curated fragments is future work.

epistemic_skills_used.contribution: adversarial design review; caught and corrected the Catala overstatement; re-based the cross-check
preregistered expected and disconfirming observations for operator-facing acceptance
verification-at-the-consumer discipline behind the recorded-check pattern and this case study's evidence records

claim_limits: Design documentation and recorded engine proofs, not a claim that every engine runs on every clause today.
Per-clause computation from arbitrary prose is future work.
The public evidence remains the two recorded drafting checks and the Hallmark design specimens.
No legal advice and no coverage claim beyond the recorded clause family.
